summary.intent: Use the GSD milestone manager to dashboard/verify/plan/execute phases of the v2.0 cipher-box milestone, resolving a stuck Phase 70.1 UAT and a false 'Executing' status on Phase 69, then parallelize planning and execution of phases 74/75/77 across a quota-limited session with scheduled resumes.
summary.outcome: Phase 70.1 was verified (SC#6 passed 6/6 after fixing a stale API + missing SDK_E2E_SECRET env issue) and marked complete; Phase 69's false 'Executing' status was root-caused to a plan-scanner filename false-positive and fixed via rename+PR #606 (merged). After a quota-limit interruption and scheduled 04:45 resume, Phase 74 was fully planned and executed (verification: 21/21 code-verified, human_needed only on CI-gated legs). Phase 75 planning was in progress (5 plans committed, validation strategy blocker resolved) when the transcript ends; phases 76, 77, 78, 79 remained unplanned/unexecuted.

repo: gsd-tools' `phase uat-passed --require-verification` predicate downgrades a phase's disk_status to 'partial' if implementation is complete + verification passed but no UAT.md exists yet — this is a display artifact, not real unfinished work

`is_active` in the manager dashboard is computed as 'any file in the phase dir modified in the last 5 minutes', so editing docs (e.g. writing a UAT stub) can spuriously flip a completed phase to look 'active'

The plan-file scanner (plan-scan.cjs) has a loose fallback matching any `.md` file whose name merely contains the substring 'PLAN' (case-insensitive) as a plan file — a doc named `*-WRITE-PLANE-RESEARCH.md` was miscounted as a 26th plan, causing plan_count(26) > summary_count(25) and a false 'partial' status
sdk-e2e test harness (vitest) does not load `.env` files — SDK_E2E_SECRET must be explicitly exported into the shell before running, or it falls back to a default secret and gets 401'd by the API

Background/spawned sub-agents launched from a repo-root cwd cannot pin themselves into a pre-existing git worktree via EnterWorktree ('EnterWorktree refuses repo-root→worktree') — attempting this wastes an agent call with zero mutations

Committing on this repo runs slow pre-commit hooks (lint-staged in the monorepo, ~1-2 min) which can look like a hang but is not; commit.gpgsign=false so autonomous commits don't block on 1Password biometrics

code.finding: Plan-file matcher loose fallback: any .md filename containing substring 'PLAN' (case-insensitive) that isn't a *-SUMMARY.md counts as a plan file, causing false positives like '*-WRITE-PLANE-RESEARCH.md'
is_active flag is computed purely from 'file in phase dir modified within last 5 minutes', not from any real process/agent liveness check

workflow: When a background stack process (API server) is suspiciously stale, check PID start time and whether it's serving compiled dist vs current source before assuming code is broken — diagnosed a false SC failure this way

For long-running autonomous multi-phase work under quota constraints, set BOTH a specific scheduled resume (CronCreate) for the expected reset time AND a safety-net second resume shortly after, in case the first resume window also gets exhausted mid-task

When resuming after an interrupted background agent, verify actual on-disk state (worktree branches, committed files) rather than trusting the failure notification's text, since agents can make real progress before an API-limit termination cuts them off

Prefer sequential 'switch main checkout to feat branch, run inline' over parallel worktree-based sub-agents when sub-agents cannot pin into existing worktrees — reuses warm build caches too and avoids the EnterWorktree limitation entirely

friction: `phase uat-passed` predicate and disk_status logic required extensive manual tracing (is_active, plan_count, resolver internals) to find the true root cause of Phase 69's false 'Executing' status — took many tool calls chasing red herrings (UAT stub, then plan count mismatch)
Live API on :3000 was a stale compiled `dist/main.js` process serving an outdated/misaligned TEST_LOGIN_SECRET, causing a full false-negative test run before being caught
SDK_E2E_SECRET not being loaded from .env by vitest caused a second false 401 failure after the API restart, requiring further diagnosis
Session/quota limit hit mid-task while 3 background planners (74, 75, 77) were running, killing all three with only partial progress persisted

EnterWorktree cannot pin a freshly spawned sub-agent into a pre-existing worktree from a repo-root cwd, wasting two agent calls (74 and 75 resume attempts) with zero mutations before the approach was abandoned
Phase 75's background plan+execute agent stopped early (~21 min) due to an internal flawed background-wait rather than quota exhaustion, requiring a relaunch
Working on `main` directly conflicts with the user's no-direct-to-main git rule, requiring branch creation and PR flow to be threaded in mid-session for the 70.1/69 fixes
